# About this site

Pharmacolibrary collects pharmacokinetic, pharmacodynamic and pharmacogenomic models from the published literature and makes them runnable.

## How to cite

Kulhanek, T., Jezek, F., Kofránek, J., Mateják, M., & Rommes, S. (2025, October). Pharmacolibrary-Free Library to Model Pharmacology. In *Modelica Conferences* (pp. 61-72). [https://doi.org/10.3384/ecp21861](https://doi.org/10.3384/ecp21861)

## Pharmacolibrary Modelica library

The reviewed models are released in the [Pharmacolibrary Modelica library](https://github.com/digital-biosystems/Pharmacolibrary) (version 26.11), which opens in OpenModelica or Dymola: 818 PK, 278 PD and 1 PGx models for 552 drugs in `Pharmacolibrary.Drugs`, organised by ATC code, and 1,306 toxicokinetic and toxicodynamic models for 452 substances in `Pharmacolibrary.NonDrugs`. Each model documents its source paper, the parameters as the paper reports them and its review status, and links to its record page here; the library's `Resources/Models/index.csv` lists them all with the verdict of each. A model is included when the automatic reviewer found that it reproduces the paper's reference values (*Reproduces paper*, or *Reproduces with caveats* when an advisory note is open), or that it runs and passes every check while the paper reports no reference value to compare it with (*Simulated*) — 2,293 simulated, 110 reproduces paper. No model is checked by a person.

## How the knowledge base is made

Literature is retrieved from PubMed and available full-text sources. Extraction follows *relevance assessment → screening → localisation → transcription → interpretation → validation*, then a model is built and its simulation compared with the paper's reported values. Parameter estimates keep the paper's labels and units.

## Record status

| Status | Meaning | popPK | PD | PGx |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Curated (human-checked)** | Authored or checked by a person against the paper. | 9 | 0 | 0 |
| **Reproduces paper** | The model built from the extracted parameters reproduces the paper's reported reference values; not human-verified. | 118 | 0 | 0 |
| **Reproduces with caveats** | Reproduces the paper's reference values, but an advisory check is open (for example, covariate scenarios not evaluated). | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| **Simulated** | The model is built and runs, and no check contradicts it, but no value the paper reported was compared with its simulation (none reported, or none extracted). Not a verdict. | 1,807 | 387 | 0 |
| **Not simulated** | Extracted and checked against closed-form rules, but no simulation has compared it with the paper yet. Not a verdict. | 58 | 5,448 | 823 |
| **Needs review** | Incomplete, inconsistent or implausible extraction, or a failed replication; the values are unverified. | 5,914 | 2,184 | 8 |
| **Rejected** | Not accepted; the values are shown for inspection only. | 6,511 | 1,631 | 24 |
| other | A pipeline status outside this vocabulary (PGx evidence records, records not yet given a status). | 8 | 0 | 4,143 |

Records per status and domain, as the drug pages show them.

Counts on this page and in the sidebar are record counts, not trust counts; each card names what it counts.

Records a curator should look at are listed in the [curator queue](/review/).
